headline: South Korea will use metal detectors and Wi Fi shutdowns to stop AI cheating in exams
label: NEWS
caption:
South Korea is taking strict steps to stop students from using smart devices and artificial intelligence during school tests. 

According to Reuters and Anadolu, authorities will introduce metal detectors and Wi Fi shutdowns at exam sites to prevent cheating scandals. 

This comes after previous incidents involving smart devices exposed vulnerabilities in the testing system. 

The new measures aim to secure fairness and stop students from using advanced technology to bypass exam rules.
